claims.claim: On Thursday, U.S. federal Judge Alvin Hellerstein rejected a joint request from Gemini and the CFTC to overturn Gemini's five-million-dollar January 2025 settlement.
claims.episode_span: Judge Alvin Hellerstein rejected a joint request from Gemini and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission
claims.source_title: U.S. judge rejects Gemini’s appeal to void $5 million settlement despite CFTC backing
claims.supporting_quote: Federal Judge Alvin Hellerstein ruled Thursday that the CFTC’s decision to reverse its position on the case was not enough to undo Gemini’s January 2025 settlement.

claims.claim: Gemini has already paid the five million dollars, and a court order still bars it from misleading the CFTC or publicly denying the settlement's findings.
claims.episode_span: Gemini has already paid that sum, and the ruling leaves a court order
claims.source_title: U.S. judge rejects Gemini’s appeal to void $5 million settlement despite CFTC backing
claims.supporting_quote: Gemini, founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss, has already paid the $5 million. The ruling also keeps the exchange under a court order prohibiting it from misleading the CFTC or publicly denying the settlement's findings.

claims.claim: Hellerstein rejected Gemini's coercion claim, and the CFTC had said the case should not have been brought.
claims.episode_span: he rejected Gemini's claim that regulators had coerced the settlement
claims.source_title: U.S. judge rejects Gemini’s appeal to void $5 million settlement despite CFTC backing
claims.supporting_quote: He also rejected Gemini’s argument that it had been coerced into settling by regulators.

claims.claim: The CFTC sued Gemini in 2023 over an alleged misleading 2017 review of a proposed bitcoin futures contract, and Gemini settled three weeks before trial without admitting or denying the allegations.
claims.episode_span: The CFTC sued in 2023, alleging Gemini misled regulators during a 2017 review
claims.source_title: U.S. judge rejects Gemini’s appeal to void $5 million settlement despite CFTC backing
claims.supporting_quote: The CFTC sued Gemini in 2023, alleging it misled regulators during a 2017 review of a proposed bitcoin futures contract.

claims.claim: Hellerstein wrote that Gemini litigated for about three years and then made a calculated decision to settle shortly before trial.
claims.episode_span: made the calculated decision to settle the case shortly before trial
claims.source_title: U.S. judge rejects Gemini’s appeal to void $5 million settlement despite CFTC backing
claims.supporting_quote: “Gemini litigated the case for approximately three years, and then, despite the preceding facts, made the calculated decision to settle the case shortly before trial,” the judge wrote.

claims.claim: The Block reported that the court treated Gemini's settlement as voluntary and that policy changes do not warrant reopening the judgment.
claims.episode_span: policy changes do not warrant reopening the judgment
claims.source_title: US federal judge denies joint Gemini-CFTC bid to undo $5 million settlement
claims.supporting_quote: The court noted that Gemini voluntarily settled three weeks before trial and that policy changes do not warrant reopening the judgment.

claims.claim: Kalshi requested a month-long Supreme Court extension and a litigator working with the company said it is in no rush while rehearing petitions and forthcoming CFTC rules are pending.
claims.episode_span: Kalshi has asked the U.S. Supreme Court for a month-long extension
claims.supporting_quote: But it also believes that pending rehearing petitions and forthcoming Commodity Futures Trading Commission rules are currently muddying the waters, the litigator said.

claims.claim: The Third Circuit sided with Kalshi and the Sixth and Ninth Circuits sided with the states; Nevada argued pending CFTC regulation would not change the Ninth Circuit outcome.
claims.episode_span: The Third Circuit has sided with Kalshi, while the Sixth and Ninth Circuits have sided with the states
claims.source_title: Kalshi in no rush for Supreme Court ruling in fight with states
claims.supporting_quote: The Third Circuit has sided with Kalshi, while the Sixth and Ninth Circuits have sided with the states.

claims.claim: Rob Lockwood of the American Gaming Association said Kalshi seems spooked about the Supreme Court taking the case next year and put sports gambling at roughly 85 percent of Kalshi's volume.
claims.episode_span: Kalshi seems spooked by the idea of the Supreme Court taking up the case next year
claims.source_title: Kalshi in no rush for Supreme Court ruling in fight with states
claims.supporting_quote: “It’s fitting that as Halloween approaches, Kalshi seems spooked by the idea of the Supreme Court taking up the case next year,” American Gaming Association spokesperson Rob Lockwood told Semafor.

claims.claim: The Supreme Court has until January to decide which cases to hear this term, and CFTC Chair Mike Selig said earlier this year he would welcome a ruling that would settle the matter.
claims.episode_span: The Court has until January to decide which cases to hear
claims.source_title: Kalshi in no rush for Supreme Court ruling in fight with states
claims.supporting_quote: The Supreme Court has until January to decide which cases it wants to hear in its current term, which began earlier this month.

claims.claim: Choice Prediction Markets launched in the UK as a virtual-money exchange giving new users £100, and Good Money Guide reported on October 16 that prediction markets are not regulated in the UK.
claims.episode_span: new users receive £100 in virtual funds rather than trading real money
claims.source_title: Choice Prediction Markets Launches in UK to Spark Debate Over FCA Regulation
claims.supporting_quote: Instead, new users receive £100 in virtual funds to test their predictions without financial risk.

claims.claim: Choice's initial market asks whether the FCA will regulate prediction markets, amid uncertainty between the FCA and the UK Gambling Commission.
claims.episode_span: the platform's first market asks whether the Financial Conduct Authority will regulate them
claims.source_title: Choice Prediction Markets Launches in UK to Spark Debate Over FCA Regulation
claims.supporting_quote: The platform’s initial market is whether the FCA will regulate prediction markets in the UK, an increasingly relevant question as the sector attracts growing interest internationally.

claims.claim: Hacksaw Gaming added a prediction-markets module for operator partners after the Malta Gaming Authority extended its B2B license to Type 3 gaming services, and said the module was developed within its existing cost base.
claims.episode_span: a module they can bolt onto existing products for peer-to-peer prediction markets
claims.source_title: Hacksaw Gaming adds prediction markets module to platform
claims.supporting_quote: The company has secured an extension to its existing B2B Critical Gaming Supply License from the Malta Gaming Authority to cover Type 3 Gaming Services, which include peer-to-peer prediction market services.

claims.claim: On Polymarket, read at 2026-10-16 11:20 UTC, the Israel-Iran ceasefire continuing through October 31 was priced at an 83.5 percent implied probability, with $658,000 in 24-hour volume.
claims.episode_span: the October 31 outcome is priced at 83.5 cents, an 83.5 percent implied probability
claims.source_title: Polymarket: Israel x Iran ceasefire continues through...?

claims.claim: Polymarket listed a market on whether the U.S. files an Ilhan Omar denaturalization case by a stated date, and the page says no complaint has been filed yet.
claims.episode_span: whether the United States files an Ilhan Omar denaturalization case by a stated date
claims.source_title: New Polymarket on US Ilhan Omar Denaturalization Case
claims.supporting_quote: No complaint has been filed yet, and any Justice Department action would require proving material, willful fraud in federal court—subject to high evidentiary standards—with civil cases having no statute of limitations.

claims.claim: A 2007 Journal of Finance paper found corporate-bond transaction costs fall with trade size and drop when TRACE disseminates prices, using bonds that traded more than nine times from January 2003 to January 2005.
claims.episode_span: Costs fell significantly as trade size rose.
claims.source_title: Corporate Bond Market Transaction Costs and Transparency
claims.supporting_quote: We find that transaction costs decrease significantly with trade size.

claims.claim: A 2020 Journal of Finance paper found post-Dodd-Frank index CDS trading remained two-tiered, with higher dealer-to-client costs explained by permanent price impact.
claims.episode_span: the index credit-default-swap market stayed two-tiered after Dodd-Frank
claims.source_title: Market Structure and Transaction Costs of Index CDSs
claims.supporting_quote: Despite regulatory efforts to promote all‐to‐all trading, the post–Dodd‐Frank index credit default swap market remains two‐tiered.

claims.claim: A 2023 Journal of Finance paper found that after transaction costs, the Fama-French five-factor model has a significantly higher squared Sharpe ratio than the q-factor and six-factor models, which had looked strong across 205 anomalies when costs were ignored.
claims.episode_span: the Fama and French five-factor model has a significantly higher squared Sharpe ratio
claims.supporting_quote: Accounting for transaction costs, the Fama and French (2015, Journal of Financial Economics , 116, 1–22; 2018, Journal of Financial Economics , 128, 234–252) five‐factor model has a significantly higher squared Sharpe ratio than either of these alternative models, while variations employing cash profitability perform better still.
